F1_data_source.verdict: FAIL — new index misalignment bug introduced by the patch
F1_data_source.summary: The patch correctly changed the data source from PLAN_DATA to GET /api/trip/<id>. However, the useEffect code passes editorTripData.days[activeDay] (array index) to CandidatesSidebar. Codex verified: PLAN_DATA.trips is grouped by city — trips[0]=[day1,day2], trips[1]=[day3,day4], trips[2]=[day5,day6], trips[3]=[day7], trips[4]=[day8,day9]. selDay resets to 0 when selTrip changes. editorTripData.days[] is a flat 9-element array indexed 0..8 = abs days 1..9. For selTrip=2, selDay=0: publishedDay=abs5, editorTripData.days[0]=abs1. Wrong-day candidates are shown.
F1_data_source.required_fix: Replace editorTripData.days[activeDay] with a day-number match: const publishedDay = PLAN_DATA.trips[selTrip]?.days?.[selDay]; const editorDay = editorTripData?.days?.find(d => Number(d.day) === Number(publishedDay?.day)); Use editorDay everywhere (CandidatesSidebar props, save payload, drop-zone mapping).

F2_adapter.summary: adaptV2Option() is now defined in the spec with correct field mappings: name_base: opt.name, location_base: opt.location_summary, cost_display: Math.round(opt.cost)+' CNY'. Verified against actual v2 option keys. CNY hardcode is acceptable for the current China trip. Codex confirmed non-blocking.

F3_cache_lock.summary: The per-trip lock is now held through the entire generate+write cycle. Invalidation also takes the per-trip lock. The stale-write race from the prior QA cycle is eliminated. Codex confirmed correct.

F4_sidebar_position.summary: M2 now explicitly specifies: position: fixed; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 300px; z-index: 100. This is not a flex column and does not compress the 280px kanban cards. The layout compression blocker from the prior QA cycle is eliminated.

F5_save_payload.verdict: FAIL — spec payload does not match save.py contract (4 mismatches)
F5_save_payload.summary: The spec defines: { trip_id, day: activeDay, slot_id, option_id }. The actual save.py expects: { trip_id, day: <integer day_n>, editor_session: <string>, mutations: [{ type: 'select', slot: slotId, option_id, origin_slot_id }] }. Mismatches: (1) slot_id at top level vs mutations[].slot — without mutations[] the handler calls req.get('mutations', []) which returns [] and silently drops the mutation; (2) editor_session missing — 409-soft concurrency detection is bypassed; (3) mutations[] array wrapper missing; (4) day: activeDay (0-indexed) writes to day-00.json which does not exist.
F5_save_payload.evidence: save.py line 166: req.get('mutations', []). save.py line 52: _is_session_conflict checks editor_session. save.py line 36: _day_path uses f'day-{day_n:02d}.json' — day_n=0 produces 'day-00.json', files are day-01.json to day-09.json.
F5_save_payload.required_fix: Spec Finding 5 / window.setEditorSelection pseudocode must show: fetch('/api/save', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ trip_id: TRIP_ID, day: editorDay.day, editor_session: editorSessionRef.current, mutations: [{ type: 'select', slot: slotId, option_id: optionId, origin_slot_id: null }] }) }). Remove the note 'activeDay used here is the 0-indexed position in data.days[]'. Note: editorDay.day is the absolute 1-indexed integer from the v2 schema, obtained via the day-number match described in F1 fix.

F6_drop_zones.verdict: FAIL — attraction slot mapping is unimplementable as written
F6_drop_zones.summary: The spec says 'for attractions, map morning cards to morning_activity, afternoon to afternoon_activity, evening to evening_activity' but KanbanView renders attractions from day.attractions as a flat array with no time-of-day sub-categories. Codex verified: PLAN_DATA attraction objects have option_id=null and slot_id=null. There is no 'morning card' concept in KanbanView's attraction section.
F6_drop_zones.evidence: Python: PLAN_DATA.trips[2].days[0].attractions = [Shuhe Old Town, Baisha Old Town, Dali Old Town] — all have option_id=None, slot_id=None. v2 day-05.json has morning_activity=Shuhe Old Town, afternoon_activity=Baisha Old Town, evening_activity=Dali Old Town. KanbanView renders these as a flat list with no slot annotation.
F6_drop_zones.required_fix: Replace vague guidance with a concrete algorithm: for each PLAN_DATA attraction card, match to v2 activity slot by comparing opt.name===attraction.name_base or opt.name_local===attraction.name_local across editorDay.slots[morning_activity|afternoon_activity|evening_activity].options[]. The matched slot's slot_id becomes the drop zone's data-slot-id. For no-match fallback, use morning_activity. For empty activity slots with no visible PLAN_DATA card, render invisible zero-layout .slot-drop[data-slot-id] elements so all 6 slot types remain droppable.

new_issue_from_codex.title: setEditorSelections state update does not cause KanbanView to re-render with selected option
new_issue_from_codex.description: KanbanView currently receives static PLAN_DATA.trips[selTrip].days[selDay] as its day prop. After drag-and-drop updates editorSelections React state, KanbanView does not re-render with the newly selected option. AC5 requires 'breakfast slot visually updates to show the selected candidate' — this cannot pass without a spec for merging editorSelections into KanbanView's data prop.
new_issue_from_codex.proposed_fix: Spec should define an effectiveDay computed value for editor mode: start from published day object, for each slot in editorDay.slots where selected_option_id is in editorSelections, adapt the selected v2 option via adaptV2Option() and merge into the appropriate meal/attraction field. Pass effectiveDay (not raw PLAN_DATA day) to KanbanView in editor mode.

qa.overall_assessment: 6 patches were applied. F2 (adapter), F3 (cache lock), and F4 (sidebar position) are correct and sufficient — those 3 prior blockers are resolved. F5 (save payload) has 4 concrete mismatches with save.py reality that cause drag-and-drop saves to silently no-op (mutations array missing) and fail to address the correct day file (0-indexed vs 1-indexed). F6 (drop zones) has an unimplementable attraction mapping because PLAN_DATA attractions have no slot_id. The F1 patch introduced a new index alignment bug — selDay misalignment between PLAN_DATA grouped trips and the flat editorTripData.days[]. Codex independently confirmed all 3 blockers. The spec is NOT ready for dev implementation.
